p.src: The Great Recession is a durable lesson in transmission asymmetry.

u.src: The Great Recession is a durable lesson in transmission asymmetry.
en: The Great Recession is a durable lesson in transmission asymmetry.

p.src: From 2007 to 2009, policy rates fell from 5.25% to near zero while liquidity facilities were expanded and special lending programs were launched. At the same time, lending standards for businesses and commercial real estate remained constrained in official commentary before easing later. That ordering is the mechanism that produces a useful rule:
